rules: AGENTS.md and docs/agent-workflow.md require independent maintenance-tool ownership, explicit read-only effects and executable dependency contracts.

modules.responsibility: Select and validate local project Markdown without mutation.
modules.interface: Repository root and paths produce deterministic typed diagnostics; CLI returns 0, 1 or 2.
modules.effects: Owns filesystem reads, fixed git ls-files listing and diagnostic output; no writes, network or example execution.

contracts.rules: Static allowlist rejects application/SDK imports including deferred/type-only imports and dynamic loaders; positive fixture admits parser and stdlib.

checks.expectation: Permitted imports pass; forbidden and dynamic imports fail.
Fixture documents, read-only CLI and ownership selection pass.
All new feature documentation has valid local links and structure.

documentation: Feature spec, plan, research, data model and quickstart document behavior; parent integrates docs/development.md and current contract navigation. Internal maintenance tooling does not change portable application usage.

review.reconciliation: Fresh independent read-only review of the integrated task-owned runtime/tooling/tests/docs and architecture scope after parent verification. All initial findings corrected and re-reviewed; actual added/modified paths covered, no moved/deleted runtime modules. Original local uv.sources overrides and untracked grid-search draft excluded. Native/package runtime manifests still match all180files; final review records preserve limits.
